mechanism_narrative: FGFR1+IGF1R forced-proximity novokine with flexible_GS4 linker (~20 A) biases signaling through GRB2/SHC1/FRS2/GAB1/PIK3R1/IRS1 adaptors via transphosphorylation, activating MAPK/ERK and PI3K/AKT pathways while sterically excluding PLCgamma-mediated cascades. IRS1 serves as a critical crosstalk mediator between FGFR1 and IGF1R (PMID:33007330), creating a positive feedback loop that amplifies MAPK signaling. The biased output upregulates muscle structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, MYOM2, TAGLN) matching the young-enriched P2_up signature, while suppressing aged IEG markers (EGR1, FOS, JUN, IL32, TXNIP) from the P1_up set.
